references.text: This is the very song that Moses introduces in 31:30, known as the Song of Moses which he delivers to the entire assembly of Israel.
Moses' earlier song at the Sea of Reeds, showing his tradition of singing before the assembly of Israel on important occasions.
God's command to Moses to write down this song and teach it to the children of Israel, now being fulfilled.
Moses gathers the elders and tribal leaders to hear the words of the song, paralleling speaking to the entire assembly.
Reference to 'the whole assembly of Israel' (kol-kehal Yisrael), the same expression used to describe the gathering of the whole people.
Stephen's speech refers to Moses who spoke to the assembly in the wilderness and received living words to pass on.
